### AuthenticationError

```ts
class AuthenticationError extends KeltaError {
    constructor(message?: string);
}
```

### AuthorizationError

Authorization error (HTTP 403)

```ts
class AuthorizationError extends KeltaError {
    constructor(message?: string);
}
```

### KeltaClient

Main Kelta client for interacting with Kelta services

```ts
class KeltaClient {
    constructor(config: KeltaClientConfig);
    readonly admin: AdminClient;
    getBaseUrl(): string;
    getAxiosInstance(): AxiosInstance;
    isValidationEnabled(): boolean;
    discover(): Promise<ResourceMetadata[]>;
    resource<T = unknown>(name: string): ResourceClient<T>;
    buildUrl(endpoint: string): string;
    clearDiscoveryCache(): void;
}
```

### KeltaError

Base error class for all Kelta errors

```ts
class KeltaError extends Error {
    constructor(message: string, statusCode?: number | undefined, details?: unknown);
}
```

### NetworkError

Network error (connection failures, timeouts)

```ts
class NetworkError extends KeltaError {
    constructor(message: string, originalError: Error);
}
```

### NotFoundError

```ts
class NotFoundError extends KeltaError {
    constructor(resource: string, id: string);
}
```

### QueryBuilder

Fluent query builder for constructing resource queries

```ts
class QueryBuilder<T = unknown> {
    constructor(resourceClient: ResourceClient<T>);
    paginate(page: number, size: number): QueryBuilder<T>;
    sort(field: string, direction: "asc" | "desc"): QueryBuilder<T>;
    filter(field: string, operator: FilterExpression["operator"], value: unknown): QueryBuilder<T>;
    fields(...fieldNames: string[]): QueryBuilder<T>;
    include(...relationships: string[]): QueryBuilder<T>;
    buildOptions(): ListOptions;
    buildQueryParams(): string;
    execute(): Promise<ListResponse<T>>;
    reset(): QueryBuilder<T>;
}
```

### ResourceClient

Client for performing CRUD operations on a specific resource

```ts
class ResourceClient<T = unknown> {
    constructor(client: KeltaClient, resourceName: string);
    getName(): string;
    list(options?: ListOptions): Promise<ListResponse<T>>;
    get(id: string, options?: GetOptions): Promise<T>;
    create(data: Partial<T>): Promise<T>;
    update(id: string, data: T): Promise<T>;
    patch(id: string, data: Partial<T>): Promise<T>;
    delete(id: string): Promise<void>;
    listChildren<C = unknown>(parentId: string, childResource: string, options?: ListOptions): Promise<ListResponse<C>>;
    getChild<C = unknown>(parentId: string, childResource: string, childId: string): Promise<C>;
    query(): QueryBuilder<T>;
    buildQueryParams(options?: ListOptions): Record<string, string | string[]>;
    buildListUrl(options?: ListOptions): string;
}
```

### generateTypes

```ts
    includeRequests?: boolean;

}): string;
```

### generateTypesFromSpec

Generate types from an already-loaded spec object

```ts
function generateTypesFromSpec(spec: unknown, outputPath: string, options?: {
    includeRequests?: boolean;
    includeResponses?: boolean;
}): {
```

```ts
        size: z.ZodNumber;

}, z.core.$strip>;
```

Resource metadata schema

```ts
const ResourceMetadataSchema: z.ZodObject<{
    name: z.ZodString;

    fields: z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
        name: z.ZodString;
        type: z.ZodEnum<{
            string: "string";
            number: "number";
            boolean: "boolean";
            date: "date";
            datetime: "datetime";
            json: "json";
            reference: "reference";
            picklist: "picklist";
            multi_picklist: "multi_picklist";
            currency: "currency";
            percent: "percent";
            auto_number: "auto_number";
            phone: "phone";
            email: "email";
            url: "url";
            rich_text: "rich_text";
            encrypted: "encrypted";
            external_id: "external_id";
            geolocation: "geolocation";
            lookup: "lookup";
            master_detail: "master_detail";
            formula: "formula";
            rollup_summary: "rollup_summary";
        }>;
        displayName: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>;
        required: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodBoolean>;
        unique: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodBoolean>;
        validation: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
            type: z.ZodEnum<{
                email: "email";
                url: "url";
                custom: "custom";
                min: "min";
                max: "max";
                pattern: "pattern";
            }>;
            value: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodUnknown>;
            message: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>;
        }, z.core.$strip>>>;
        defaultValue: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodUnknown>;
        referenceTarget: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>;
    }, z.core.$strip>>;
    operations: z.ZodArray<z.ZodString>;
    authz: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodObject<{
        read: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodString>>;
        create: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodString>>;
        update: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodString>>;
        delete: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodArray<z.ZodString>>;
        fieldLevel: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodRecord<z.ZodString, z.ZodArray<z.ZodString>>>;
    }, z.core.$strip>>;
}, z.core.$strip>;
```

### ScriptLayoutRule

SCRIPT rule — a general client event handler evaluating a sandboxed `@kelta/formula` expression on its `when` events. The result is treated as a validation message: a non-empty string surfaces on `target` (or the form when `target` is omitted); a boolean `true` uses the static `message`; any falsy result clears it. On `onBeforeSave` a non-empty message blocks the submit (client-side UX only — the server record-event hook, slice 7, is authoritative and cannot be bypassed via the API).

```ts
interface ScriptLayoutRule extends BaseLayoutRule {
    kind: "script";
    target?: string;
    expression: string;
    message?: string;
}
```
